The Graphics Quality presets of the engine at `319075e3f92b`: each row of `Strata/src/Strata/Renderer/RendererQuality.cpp` with its value in the four presets, as the `Renderer.Quality` settings section writes it (High is the default). Custom uses the values a project or a player sets.

## Rows

| Field | Title | Low | Medium | High | Ultra | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ShadowResolution` | Shadow resolution | `1024` | `2048` | `AutoFine` | `8192` | Texels each way of every sun shadow cascade: sharper sun shadows for more GPU memory and time. Auto: 2048 below 1440 output rows, 4096 from 1440 (about one texel per screen pixel at each cascade's far end); AutoFine: 4096 and 8192. Memory per view: cascades x size x size x 4 bytes (4 x 4096: 256 MiB). |
| `ShadowCascades` | Shadow cascades | `3` | `4` | `5` | `5` | Sun shadow cascades: fewer cost less GPU time and memory but spread the same texels over the shadow distance; a fifth one sharpens the shadows within about 1.5 m of the camera. |
| `LocalShadowAtlasSize` | Point and spot shadow atlas | `2048` | `4096` | `4096` | `8192` | Texels each way of the shadow atlas point and spot lights share: sharper shadows of those lights for more GPU memory (4096: 64 MiB per view). |
| `LocalShadowMaxTile` | Largest point and spot shadow tile | `512` | `1024` | `1024` | `2048` | The largest tile of the atlas a point or spot light's shadow gets (at most the atlas): tiles follow how large the light looks on screen, and larger ones are sharper. |
| `MaxShadowedLocalLights` | Shadowed point and spot lights | `4` | `16` | `64` | `256` | Point and spot lights that cast shadows in a view, those that matter most first (nearer, larger on screen, brighter); the others light without shadows. More cost more GPU time; the atlas holds at most about 37, 149 and 597 point lights at 2048, 4096 and 8192 texels. |
| `LocalShadowViewsPerFrame` | Point and spot shadow updates per frame | `12` | `12` | `24` | `48` | Shadow views of point and spot lights drawn again per frame when lights or what they shine on move (a point light has six, a spot light one): more keep many moving lights' shadows current and fill a new view's shadows sooner, for more GPU time in such frames. |
| `LODErrorPixels` | Level of detail error (pixels) | `2.0` | `1.0` | `1.0` | `0.5` | Levels of detail are chosen so that their error spans at most this many pixels on screen: lower draws more triangles (0: full detail). |
| `MinProjectedPixels` | Smallest drawn size (pixels) | `1.0` | `0.5` | `0.5` | `0.25` | Meshes smaller on screen than this many pixels are not drawn: higher draws fewer (0: all). |
| `ShadowFilterQuality` | Shadow filter quality | `8` | `16` | `24` | `32` | Taps of the sun's shadow edges where they are wider than a shadow texel, and half the taps of rect lights' soft shadows: more taps leave less grain in soft shadows for more GPU time (8, 16, 24 or 32). |
| `ContactShadows` | Contact shadows | `0` | `0` | `0` | `0` | Steps of the sun's contact shadows, which ground small objects below the shadow map's detail: more steps find thinner contacts for more GPU time, but they can shimmer in motion, so no preset turns them on (0: off; 1 to 3 count as 4). |
| `AmbientOcclusionQuality` | Ambient occlusion quality | `Low` | `Medium` | `High` | `Ultra` | Samples of the ambient occlusion that darkens creases and contacts, in scenes that use it: Low 1x4, Medium 2x6, High 3x8, Ultra 4x12 (slices x steps each side); more samples give smoother, truer occlusion for GPU time that grows about with their product. |
| `EnvironmentResolution` | Sky reflection resolution | `256` | `256` | `512` | `512` | Texels each way of each face of the sky's reflection map: 512 keeps mirror-like reflections of the sky sharp at high resolutions, for 12 MiB more GPU memory per view than 256 (24 MiB under the physical atmosphere). |
| `Reflections` | Screen-space reflections | `Off` | `Checkerboard` | `Spatial` | `SpatialHigh` | How the screen-space reflections of scenes that use them are traced: Off draws none; Checkerboard traces at half resolution and needs TAA; Spatial and SpatialHigh trace every pixel at full resolution with or without TAA (32 and 48 steps), for more GPU time and about 150 MiB more GPU memory per view at 3840x2160. |
| `MotionBlurQuality` | Motion blur samples | `Off` | `Samples8` | `Samples12` | `Samples16` | Samples per pixel of the motion blur, in scenes that use it: more samples show less streak noise where things move fast, for more GPU time (Off: no motion blur). |
| `GlobalIllumination` | Global illumination | `Off` | `Off` | `High` | `High` | Experimental. Bounce light and sky occlusion traced in the world around the camera, for scenes that turn it on: sunlit floors light the walls and colored surfaces tint their neighbors. Low traces a coarser, shorter field for about 25 MiB of GPU memory per view, High a finer one for about 156 MiB and several milliseconds of GPU time at 3840x2160; Off draws none. |
| `ReflectionProbeResolution` | Reflection probe resolution | `128` | `128` | `256` | `256` | Texels each way of each face of the reflection probes' pictures: 256 keeps polished metal's reflections of nearby things sharp, for about 51 MiB more GPU memory per view that shows a probe (17 MiB at 128, 68 MiB at 256 for 16 probes) and more GPU time when a probe's picture is prepared. |

## The section's other fields

No preset sets these; each has its default.

| Field | Title | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AntiAliasing` | Anti-aliasing | `Scene` | How jagged edges are smoothed: Scene uses the game's own method; Off is the sharpest and costs nothing; FXAA and Morphological smooth each frame on its own (Morphological keeps more texture detail); TAA also calms shimmer by blending earlier frames. Each costs a little GPU time. |
| `ChromaticAberration` | Chromatic aberration | `Scene` | Scene shows the color fringes toward the image's corners where the game uses them; Off never. |
| `DepthOfField` | Depth of field | `Scene` | Scene shows the depth of field of the game's cameras that use it; Off keeps every distance in focus and saves its GPU time. |
| `FilmGrain` | Film grain | `Scene` | Scene shows the game's film grain where it uses it; Off never adds grain. |
| `MotionBlur` | Motion blur | `Scene` | Scene shows the game's motion blur where it uses it; Off never blurs what moves and saves its GPU time. |
| `Preset` | Preset | `High` | The quality preset: Low, Medium, High or Ultra sets every other option to its value; Custom uses the values chosen for them. |
